tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// gzungs sngags byin rlabs can 'don thabs dang bcas pa yid bzhin nor bu'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// mnyam med ston pa shākya'i tog /des gsung mi bslu bden pa'i stobs// bsam mi khyab la dad byas te// gsang rig gzungs sngags khyad par can// klog dang 'chang bas gnas skabs kyi// bar chad rkyen zhi mthar thug tu// byang chub lam la 'god nus pa'i// gzungs dril phan yon 'dir dgod bya// de la thog mar 'phags pa sprin chen po'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas blo gros mi zad pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dri ma med pa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul pas dwang bar byed pa'i grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi srung la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lhun po'i rgyal po mngon par 'phags pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam pa'i chos kun tu srung ba'i tog tu gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sangs rgyas de dag gi mtshan rnams thos nas 'dzin tam/ kun tu chub par byed dam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ gzhan dag la yang dag par ston na de dag sems can dmyal ba sogs rigs drug gi gnas su skye ba'i skabs ma yin mi srid de gnas med do// mtshan 'di rnams thos nas mi 'dzin na de shin tu las ngan pa'i mthur nges la/

'dzin pa ni sangs rgyas bye snyed la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i bsod nams kyi mthu yin pa shes par bya'o/ zhes gsungs/ ༈ /shes pas thams cad grub pa mthar phyin pa'i mdo las/ oṃ stai ya dh+we sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya gar+bhe dz+wa la/ dharmā dhā tu gar+bhe/ sam̐ ha ra ṇa āḥyuḥ saṃ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa man+ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi ma le bi shud+dhe swā hā/ rig pa chen mo bi ma la uṣ+ṇī ṣa'i gzungs 'di ni/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ bris sam/ klog gam/ ming nyan par byed na/ de mtshams med pa lnga dang*/ mi dge ba bcu dang*/ sdig pa'i las ci byas pa thams cad ma lus par byang bar 'gyur ro// rig pa chen mo 'di lus sam mgul du thogs na de lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin la sogs pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas nyid du lta bar 'gyur ro/ ༈ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na su bi ni sh+tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye ma hā puṇ+ye a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye dzñā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra pa ri shud+dha dharma te ga ga na sa mut+ga te swa bhā ba bi shud+dhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ zhes tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs 'di bri ba'am/ 'dzin tam klog par 'gyur ba'i sems can de dag tshe zad pa'ang*/ rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro// shi 'phos nas bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro// sems can dmyal ba dang*/ gshin rje byol song gi skye gnas ngan par mi skye ba dang*/ sdig pa'i phung po ri rab tsam yang byang bar 'gyur ro// bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro// 'chi ba'i dus sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus mngon sum du lung ston par mdzad de sangs rgyas stong gis phyag rkyong bar 'gyur ro// 'di 'dzin pa'i sems can de la rgyal po chen po bzhis rtag tu srung zhing skyob par 'gyur ro// sems can gang gi rna lam du thos pa thams cad kyang byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro// bud med kyi lus su 'chang na bud med kyi lus kyi tha mar 'gyur ro// dper na rgya mtsho chen po bzhi thigs pa re re nas bgrang bar nus kyi gzungs 'di'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i tshad ni bgrang bar mi nus so zhes tshe dpag tu med pa'i mdo sde las phan yon rgya cher gsungs so/

༈ /tad+ya thā/ ga te ga te pā ra ga te pā ra saṃ ga te bo dhi swā hā/ shes rab phar phyin gyi sngags/ rig pa chen po'i sngags/ bla na med pa'i sngags/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i sngags/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags zhes phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs/ na mo bha ga wa te/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā ye/ oṃ na ta da ti ta/ i li shi/ i li shi/ mi li shi/ mi li shi/ bhi na yan/ bhi na yan/ na mo bha ga wa te pra da t+yaṃ pra ti/ i ri ti/ i ri ti/ mi ri ti/ mi ri ti/ shu ri ti/ shu ri ti/ u shu ri/ u shu ri/ bhu yu ye/ bhu yu ye swā hā/ rdo rje gcod pa'i snying po 'di lan gcig bzlas pas rdo rje gcod pa khri dgu stong bklags pa dang mnyam mo// sa phyogs gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di tha na tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa tsam 'don tam ston pa'i sa phyogs de lha dang lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod rten du 'gyur ba yin na su zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di len pa dang 'bri ba dang*/ 'dzin pa dang 'chang ba dang klog pa dang*/ kun chub par byed pa dang*/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de ngo mtshar rab dang ldan par 'gyur ba lta ci smros te/ sa phyogs de ni ston pa'i bla ma lta bu yang rung bar gnas so// zhes gsungs/ ༈ /thar pa chen po'i mdo las 'di ltar byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgras/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar gzungs sngags 'di skad ces smras so// na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṅghā ya/ a dan+ti dhā ra ṇī/ tad+ya thā/ ā kā sha ni ba bī ni/ sarba dharma ni pā ni/ i sha ma da/ pi pa sha na/ bi ma la/ su pa ri dharmā ni kha na/ pa ra ru ni/ tsa ya ta ma le/ tse le/ hu lu hu lu/ shi bi te man+t+raḥswā hā/ gzungs 'di thos ma thag tu sems thag pa nas blang ba dang*/ bcang ba dang*/ nyin re bzhin klog pa dang*/ kha ton tu bgyid pa dang*/ yi dam du mi bskyud par bgyid na gang zag de mngon par byang ma chub kyi bar du ngan song gsum du ltung bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs/

༈ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi mdo las gsungs pa'i gser bzang dri med kyi gzungs ni/ tad+ya thā/ sid+dhi/ sid+dhi/ su sid+dhi/ mo tsa ni/ mok+ṣa ni/ muk+te/ bi muk+te/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ māṃ ga l+ye/ hi ra ṇ+ya gar+bhe/ rat+na gar+bhe/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni/ pa ra ma ar+tha sā dha ni/ ma na se/ ma hā ma na se/ ad+bhu te/ at+yad+bhu te/ bī ta bha ye/ su bar+ṇe/ brah+ma gho ṣe/ brah+ma dh+yā ṣi te/ sarba ar+the ṣu/ a pa rā dzi te/ sarba tra a pra ti ha te/ tsa tuṣ+ṣaṣī bhū ta ko ṭi bhā ṣi te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ swā hā/ sems can gang dag dug gsum gyi dbang gis ngan song du skye ba rnams gzungs 'di 'chang zhing klog pa de mi skye ba dang*/ lhag par tshul khrims 'chal pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa myong ba'ang de bzhin gshegs pa 'di'i mtshan dang gzungs 'chang bas rim gyis sgrib pa byang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med do// tad+ya thā/ ghu me ghu me/ i mi ni mi hi/ ma ti ma ti/ sap+ta ta thā ga ta sa mā dh+ya dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ a ti ma te/ pā le/ pā paṃ sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ nā sha ya/ ma ma bud+dhe/ bud+dhet+ta me/ u me ku me/ bud+dha k+ṣe tra pa ri sho dha ni/ dha me/ ni dha me/ me ru me ru/ me ru shi kha re/ sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu ni bā ra ṇi/ bud+dhe su bud+dhe/ bud+dhā dhiṣ+ṭhā na/ rak+ṣan+tu me/ sarba de ba/ sa me a sa me sa ma n+wā ha ran+tu me/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sha me sha me/ pra sha man+tu me sarba i t+yu pa da ba bya dha yaḥ pū ra ṇi pū ra ṇi/ pū ra ya me/ sarba a shā ya bai ḍūr+ya pra ti bhā se sarba pā paṃ k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun po de dag la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ badz+re pā sha dhā ra ṇi/ sa ma sa ma/ sa man+ta/ a pra ti ha ta badz+re/

sha ma sha ma/ pra sha man+tu/ sarba bya dha ya/ ku ru ku ru sarba karma ṇi/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra bha ga wanra badz+ra pā ṇi/ sarba ā shā ya me pa ri pū ra ya swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ a ghu/ ma ghu/ ta ra ghu/ ma ma ghu/ ghu ro hā hū he mra mra mra mra/ dzu dzu ri/ dzu ri swā hā/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan dang gzungs 'di dag 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ mchod dam/ gtsang mar byas te/ sems can thams cad la mchog tu snying rje bas/ gzungs kyi tshig 'di dag lan stong rtsa brgyad du bton na/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dgongs par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sems par 'gyur/ rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyang yang dag par bsrung bar 'gyur/ lha thams cad dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ tshangs pa thams cad dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis kyang yongs su bskyang bar 'gyur/ mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ nad thams cad kyis mi btab par 'gyur/ ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur/ 'chi ba dang*/ dgra dang*/ dgon pa'i gnod pa dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ dgra thams cad kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar 'gyur/ ci bsams pa'i bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs so/ ༈ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ na mo rat+na t+ya yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ti/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pā raṃ pa ra ṇe me sarba satwā nāñtsa swā hā/ 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs 'di nyid kyi phan yon kyang*/ rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro// dus gsum du bzlas brjod byas na mtshams med pa lnga byang bar 'gyur ro// lan gcig bzlas na ltas ngan pa dang rmi lam ngan pa dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad med par 'gyur ro// gang zhig snying rjes non te ri dwags dang bya dang mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyang rung ste/

'chi kha'i rna khung du brjod na de ngan song gsum du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro// mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'am/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa'am/ 'phags pa la skur pa btab kyang rung ste/ 'chi khar rtsig pa la gzungs sngags 'di bris pa mthong na yang*/ de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur na 'dogs pa dang bzlas brjod byed pa lta ci smos te/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa de nyid byon nas 'di skad du rigs kyi bu tshur nga'i gan du shog ces gsung bar 'gyur ro/ ༈ /na mo bha ga wa te/ sarba durga te pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po gsang ba'i snying po 'di rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ gang 'ga' zhig ming tsam nyan tam/ 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ bris nas kyang mgo'am/ gtsug phud dam/ dpung pa'am/ mgul par btags te 'chang bar byed na de'i tshe 'di la dus ma yin par 'chi ba brgyad dang*/ 'chi ba dang 'brel ba'i rmi lam 'byung ba'am/ ngan song dang 'brel ba'i mtshan ma de dag thams cad rmi lam tsam du yang mi 'byung bar gsungs so/ ༈ /na mo rat+na tā yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dzñā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ ar+ha te bh+yaḥ samyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki ti shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ra dhu ra/ iṭ+ṭe biṭ+ṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa ye/ ku su me ku su ma ba re/ i li mi li tsi ti dz+wa la ma pa na ye swā hā/ gzungs kyi phan yon yang don zhags rgyud las/ spyan ras gzigs kyis gsol pa/

bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po 'di ni de ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba lags so// lan gcig bton pas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi po dag kyang byang bar 'gyur ro// mtshams ma mchis pa lnga po dag kyang ma lus par yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro// ji skad bshad pa bzhin du nan tan du bgyid pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ba lags na bzlas brjod bgyid pa dang*/ ji skad bshad pa bzhin du sgrub pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags/ gang 'ga' zhig gis rig sngags 'di klog pa dang*/ 'don pa dang*/ 'dzin par bgyid na/ bdag gis de dag gi smon pa ci mchis pa de bzhin du 'grub par bgyid pa lags so zhes gsungs so/ ༈ /oṃ pad+moṣ+ṇī ṣa bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭa/ don yod zhags pa dang pad+ma gtsug tor gyi snying po khro bo'i rim par phye ba/ gzungs sngags chen po bcu po 'di lan gcig dran nam/ klog gam ming bzung ba yang dran nam/ lag na rdo rje dus tshigs gcig tu dran pa tsam gyis kyang de'i mtshams med pa lnga byed pa mnar med par gzhol ba/ bskal par gnas pa yang*/ de'i thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur la/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa bsags pa rnams zad par 'gyur/ lus yongs su dag cing dri ma med par 'gyur/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang bral bar 'gyur/ tshe brje ba 'phos nas 'jig rten khams bde ba can du pad+ma dag la rdzus te skye bar 'gyur/ tshe rabs su tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa gnyis su nam yang ngan 'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag brgyad cur 'khor los sgyur ba mchog tu 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag brgyad cur 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa gnyis su 'jig rten khams mngon par dga' bar bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su 'jig rten gyi khams 'jig rten rnam par gzigs par skye bar 'gyur/

tshe rabs su tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag bcu gnyis su nor bu 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur/ bskal pa khri phrag brgyad cur 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas ri bo gru 'dzin du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ bskal pa stong phrag drug cu rtsa dgur 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag brgyad cur dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag sum cur sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi nang du brgya byin nyid byed par 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag lnga bcu rtsa gnyis su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams 'jug par 'gyur/ bskal pa stong phrag nyi shu 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid la spyod par 'gyur/ nam yang ma'i mngal du skye bar mi 'gyur/ gang dang gang du skye ba thams cad du brdzus te skye bar 'gyur/ thams cad du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur te/ lag na rdo rje de ltar rigs sngags lan cig dran pa tsam gyis/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ ༈ /oṃ a mo gha pū dza ma ṇi pad+ma badz+ra ta thā ga ta bi lo ki te sa man+ta pra sā ra hūm̐/ don yod par mchod pa'i nor bu'i snying po'o// don yod pa mchod pa'i nor bu'i snying po 'di tha na sgra tsam rna ba'i bu gar ltung bar 'gyur ba dang*/ bris pa rnams lta ba dang*/ po ti'am/ yi ge'am/ rtsig pa'i gyang la bris pa lta bar byed pa de mtshams med pa lnga'i sdig pa thams cad yongs su gtugs par 'gyur ro// sngon bsags pa'i mnar med par gzhol ba'i sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa de thams cad rnam par nyams par byed do// yongs su gtugs par 'gyur ro// shis 'phos nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur te/ pad+ma las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro// ji srid byang chub la thug gi bar sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye zhing tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/

༈ na maḥn ba na ba tī nāṃ/ ta thā ga ta gaṅgā nā dī bā lu kā nāṃ/ ko ṭi ni yu ta sha ta sa ha srā ṇāṃ/ oṃ bo bo ri/ tsa ri ṇi tsa ri/ mo ri go ri tsa la bā ri swā hā/ gang la la zhig gis gsang sngags kyi rgyal po'i snying po ma nor bar yi ge bris la rtag tu bton te/ mchod pa'i las byas la lus la thogs na rig pa de nyid kyis bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa mdzad de/ phas kyi rgol ba'i dgra thams cad dang*/ shar gnyer ba rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags la sogs pa thams cad kyang gnod par byed par mi 'gyur te/ 'jigs shing skrag nas so sor 'byer bar 'gyur ro// gang la la zhig gis rig pa 'don pa de dang gtam byas pa yang mtshams med pa lnga'i las kyi sgrib pa yang yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro// gang la la zhig gis sngags pa de'i sgra thos sam/ grib ma phog gam/ lus la reg kyang rung ste/ de'i tshe rabs gzhan gyis las kyi sgrib pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro// gang rig pa 'don pa de'i lus la dug gis mi tshugs/ me yis mi tshugs/ chus khyer bar mi 'gyur/ gdon thams cad kyis glags mi rnyed/ thog 'bab par mi 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis srung ba dang*/ bskyab par mdzad cing spyan ras kyis 'tsho bar mdzad do// lha thams cad dang*/ dam tshig can thams cad kyis kyang de la stong grogs byed par 'gyur te/ gzhan gyi rig sngags dang*/ byad dang*/ sbyor ba thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ ༈ /oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi hūm̐/ 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po'i byin rlabs nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdo rgyud kun las rgya cher gsungs pa dang*/ de'i mtshan dang gzungs lan gcig dran pas kyang gza' klu sogs 'byung gdon gyi gnod pa/ byad phur rbod gtong sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad las rgyal ba dang*/

mthing shog la gser gyis bris nas mgul du 'chang na gang zag de dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa 'dzin pa dang*/ dus rtag tu dag pa'i zhing nas dag pa'i zhing du 'tshang rgya ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa dge bsnyen lcags kyi rkang pa can la 'phags pa 'jam dpal dge slong gi gzugs kyis gsungs te nam mkhar gshegs pa'i lo rgyus rgya cher 'byung ngo*/ ༈ /oṃ bi pu la gar+bhe ma ṇi pra dhe/ ta thā ga ta ni rde sha ni/ ma ṇi ma ṇi su pra dhe/ bi ma le sā ga ra gam+bhī re hūm̐ hūm̐ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ bud+dha bi lo ki te gu h+ya/ a dhiṣ+ṭhi te gar+bhe swā hā/ pad+ma dha ra a mo gha dza ya ti/ tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/ sdig sgrib kun 'joms kyi gzungs 'di ni/ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa'i phrin las kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa bdun pa nas gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyis mkha' 'gro ma gar gyi dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med dpag tu med pa 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba yod de/ de na gnas pa'i sems can rnams nyon mongs pa rags pa dgang bar dka' ba/ gdul dka' ba/ mi dge ba bcu la spyod pa/ mtshams med pa lnga la spyod pa/ bslab pa gsum yal bar dor ba/ dkon mchog gi dkor la bab col du spyod pa'i sems can rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ khyod kyis sdig sgrib kun 'joms kyi gzungs 'di zungs shig chongs shig klogs shig sdig pa can la ston cig 'di la gces spras gyis shig rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ 'gro ba gang yang rung ste/ sdig sgrib kun 'joms kyi gzungs 'di nyin re zhing brgya rtsa brgyad bton na/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs bcu gsum 'jig pa'i nus pa yod do// bcu gsum po gang zhe na/

mes mi tshugs/ chus mi tshugs/ g.yang la mi ltung*/ thog rdib tu mi 'gro/ rlung gi mi 'degs/ dug gis mi tshugs/ dug sbyar mas mi tshugs/ gza'i gnod pas mi tshugs/ byad stims kyis mi tshugs/ dus ma yin par 'chi bas mi tshugs/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis mi tshugs/ rims drag pos mi tshugs/ rgyal po'i chad pas phog ste 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro// gzhan yang yon tan bcu gsum thob ste/ bcu gsum po gang zhe na/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de nyid gzugs bzang bar 'gyur ro// dbyangs snyan par 'gyur ro// ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro// sems can kyi don dpag med nus par 'gyur ro// phrin las thams cad la thogs pa med par 'gyur ro// de'i las kyi rnam par smin pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro// 'khor dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// tshe ring bar 'gyur ro// bstan bcos thams cad la thogs pa med par 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas kyi sras su 'gyur ro// yid la re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// de ltar mthun pa'i phyogs bcu gsum thob ste/ skye ba 'di'i 'og rol tu bde ba can du 'jig rten gyi khams su skyes nas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ro// de ltar yon tan bcu gsum thob par ma gyur na/ nga nyid kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bslus par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so/ ༈ /oṃ swa sti ka ma lāk+ṣi/ bi pu la sam+bha be/ dharma dhā tu/ go tsa re swā hā/ gzungs 'di brjod ma thag tu ngan song dang ngan 'gro thams cad ni rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ sa yang g.yo bar 'gyur/ rnga bo che dag gi sgra yang grags par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang legs so zhes bya ba byin no// de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis bka' stsal pa/

kye 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na 'khod pa'i sems can rnams nam mkha'i snying po dkyil 'khor mngon sum pa rnams kyi swā hā'i mchog gi gzungs 'byung ba shin tu dka' ba/ bsod nams chen po/ sdig pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa thams cad sreg pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ma/ rin po che'i phung por gyur pa 'di nyon cig dang*/ 'di thos pas dri ma med par 'gyur zhing legs par khrus byas par 'gyur la/ shin tu rnam par dag par 'gyur ro// pad+ma lta bur 'gyur te 'khor ba'i 'dam gyis mi gos so// nyi ma lta bur 'gyur te sems can thams cad snang bar byed do// zla ba lta bur 'gyur te sems can thams cad rab tu sim par byed do// nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur te ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad kyis mi gos so// sa gzhi lta bur 'gyur te mtho dman med do// lhun po lta bur 'gyur te sems can thams cad kyis bskyod par mi nus so// thar pa lta bur 'gyur te bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyis mi gos so// de la sogs pa yon tan stong phrag bgrang ba tshad med grangs med pa dag thob par 'gyur te/ nyan pa dang*/ 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ brjod pa dang*/ ston pa tsam dang*/ bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis gang ci yang rung ste/ de'i 'dod pa dang*/ smon pa dang*/ re ba de dag 'grub par 'gyur ro// bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis kyang char ches pa dang*/ char mi 'bab pa dang*/ sdang bas krugs pa dang*/ mi nad dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ gnod pa 'byung ba dang*/ 'jig pa'i dus dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ chom rkun dang*/ dgon pa dang*/ g.yul 'gyed pa dang*/ gcan gzan dang*/ mu ge'i sdug bsngal rnams las yongs su thar bar byed la/ bde ba dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ ci 'dod pa dang*/ ci dga' ba thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/

hūm̐ hūm̐ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha phaṭa phaṭa sarba du ri ni mat+ti duḥswab+na shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sangs rgyas stong gi sngags 'di ni// gtsug gtor 'bar ba zhes grags te// las rnams gang dag stong phrag dang*// brgyad cu dang ni dgu phrag lnga// rnam pa sna tshogs las rnams dang*// bkra shis dpal grags thams cad byed// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// lan gcig bzlas pas sel bar byed// bgegs rnams ma lus rab tu 'jig /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ ༈ /oṃ i ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bi ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ a hi raṃ bi na raṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe raṃ a a a swā hā/ oṃ bi rasti bi rasti swā hā/ yangs pa'i grong khyer gyi gzungs 'dis sku glud zos pa/ tshul 'chal dam grib/ nyams grib/ mtshams med kyi las sogs dag par 'gyur/ ༈ /oṃ bākye te dzā ya/ oṃ bākye ṣa ṣe swa/ oṃ bākye kha na dza ye/ oṃ bākye niṣ+ṭha a/ oṃ bākye ya na maḥ oṃ bākye daṃ na maḥ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan 'di nyid lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pas mtshams med pa lnga'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro/ ༈ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med la// bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// bar chad thams cad bsal du gsol// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bi gh+nāṃ bi nā ya kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi rgya gzhung las/ thun mong dngos grub sna tshogs dang*// sangs rgyas lo zlas 'grub par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ ma yengs par zla ba gcig bsgoms na/ de nyid du sangs rgyas par byed/ tho rangs thun re bsgoms na/ 'chi khar chos sku dang gzugs sku thob/ dbang 'brel lan gcig thob na/ mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang*/ bar dor sangs mi rgya mi srid do// bla ma mgon po dbyer med la zhes sogs gsol 'debs sh+lo ka lan gcig thos pa dang*/

gzungs sngags gser gyis bris nas btags na yang*/ 'chi khar zhal mthong ba dang*/ bar dor ḍa ma ru'i lce la btags nas bde ba can du 'dren par the tshom med par mgon po nyid kyis sha wa ri la lan gsum gsum gsungs so/ ༈ /bdud sdig can gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs nas 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang theg pa chen po la rab tu dad cing mos te theg pa chen po bsrung bar 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang zhig khe dang grags pa'i phyir ram/ gzhan skrag par bya ba'i phyir ram/ gzhan la rdzun bya ba'i phyir ram/ nor dang zang zing gi phyir ram/ gzhan gyi yid la sbyor ba tsam gyi phyir theg pa chen po 'di 'dzin par byed na bden yang rung*/ brdzun yang rung*/ bdag cag gis de'i tshe/ gang zag de'i 'jigs pa bsal ba'i phyir gsang sngags 'di 'bul lo/ ts+yog kye/ ta ta la ts+yog kyi/ lo ha le/ ma hā lo ha le/ a la tsa la ta la swā hā/ sngags 'dis ni sems stor ba rnams dang*/ 'jigs skrag dang*/ chos smra ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i chos kyi bar du mi gcod pa dang*/ mu stegs can 'dul ba dang*/ bdag gi lus srung ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i chos srung ba dang*/ theg pa chen po srung ba'i slad du gsang sngags 'di 'bul lo// gang gis gsang sngags 'di yid la bgyis na ba glang rmig pa'i 'jigs pa dang bral bar 'gyur/ gal te 'brog dgon pa'am/ yul sa stong pa bag tsha ba'i gnas su mchis na yang 'jigs par mi 'gyur/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ seng ge dang*/ stag dang*/ spyang ki dang*/ dgras 'jigs pa dang*/ rgyal po'i chad pa'i 'jigs pa las kyang thar bar 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das gang gis gsang sngags 'di yid la bgyid na 'jigs pa de dag la sogs pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das gsang sngags 'di 'dzin pa la bdag gis bskyab cing sba ba ni ji ltar ru sbal yan lag drug sbed pa bzhin no// bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni g.yo dang sgyus 'di skad du smra ba ma lags kyi gang gzungs sngags 'di 'dzin pa la bdag cag gis mthu stobs btang ngo*// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud sdig to can la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to// 'gro ba thams cad dang 'khor rnam bzhi la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir gsang sngags 'di bzhes so zhes bka' stsal pas gzungs 'di 'chang ba dang bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis nam yang gang zag de la bar du gcod par mi nus par byin gyis brlabs so/

༈ /bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di/ lus la thogs sam glegs bam du bgyis te 'dzin pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de bsod nams ji snyed cig bskyed par 'gyur/ de skad ces gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' chen po sman pa'i rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to// sman pa'i rgyal po rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gaṅgā'i klung brgyad cu'i bye ma snyed la bsti stang du byed/ btsun par byed/ ri mor byed/ mchod par byed na/ sman pa'i rgyal po 'di ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de gzhi de las bsod nams mang du bskyed dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang lags so// bde bar gshegs pa mang lags so// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman pa'i rgyal po khyod mos par bya'o// khong du chud par bya'o// sman pa'i rgyal po rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las tha na tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam 'dzin pa dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kun chub par byed pa dang*/ nan tan gyis bslabs na/ sman pa'i rgyal po rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de gzhi de las de bas ches bsod nams mang du bskyed do// de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman pa'i rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das gang dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lus la thogs sam glegs bam du bgyis te 'dzin pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba ba'i slad du gzungs sngags kyi tshig rnams stsal bar bgyi'o// tad+ya thā/ a n+ye ma n+ye/ ma ne ma ma ne/ tsit+ta tsa ri te/ sha me sha ma yi tā bi/ shān+ta/ muk+te/ muk+ta/

ta me/ sa me a be sha me sa ma sa me/ dza ye/ k+ṣa ye/ ak+ṣa ye/ ak+ṣa ṇi/ shān+te/ sha mi te dhā ra ṇi/ ā lo ka bha se/ pra t+ya bek+ṣa ṇi/ bi bi ru a bh+yan+ta ra ṇi/ biṣ+ṭe/ a t+yan+ta/ pa ri shud+dhi/ ud ku lo/ mud ku me/ a ra ḍe/ ba ra ḍe/ shu kāk+ṣi/ a sa ma sa me/ bud+dha bi lo ki te/ dharma sa rī k+ṣi te/ saṅgha ni ra gho ṣa ṇi/ nir gho ṣa ṇi/ bha yā bha ya/ sho dha ni man+t+re man+t+ra/ k+ṣa ya ṭe/ rū dra kau sha l+ye/ ak+ṣa ye/ ak+ṣa bā nā tā yā pa lo/ a man+ya na tā ya/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gaṅgā'i klung drug cu'i bye ma snyed kyis bshad pa ste/ gang gis mdo sde 'di lta bu 'dzin pa chos smra ba 'di lta bu de dag dang 'gal bar bgyis na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad la de 'khus so// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman pa'i rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to// sman pa'i rgyal po khyod kyis gzungs sngags kyi tshig rnams smras pas/ sems can mang po'i don byas shing sman pa'i rgyal po sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang sba bar byas pa legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no// de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' chen po rab tu sbyin pas 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang chos smra ba 'di lta bu dag gi ched du gzungs kyi tshig rnams stsal bar bgyi ste/ des chos smra ba 'di lta bu de dag la glags lta ba gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed pa 'di lta ste/ gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/ srul po'am/ gshed byed dam/ grul bum mam/ 'di dag glags lta ba rnams kyis kyang glags mi rnyed do// de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu sbyin pas de'i tshe gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag smras so// tad+ya thā/

dz+wa la/ mahā dz+wa le/ uk+ke/ muk+ke/ a ḍe a ḍa ba ti/ nṛ ṭ+ye nṛ ṭ+yā ba ti/ iṭ+ṭa ni/ biṭ+ṭi tsiṭ+ṭe ni/ nṛ ṭa ṭi ni/ nṛ ṭa ṭū ba ti swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis gsungs shing rjes su yi rang ba ste/ gang gis chos smra ba 'di lta bu 'di dang 'gal bar bgyis na de de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'khus lags so// de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang chos smra ba de dag la glo ba brtse bas sman pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba'i slad du gzungs sngags kyi tshig rnams brjod par bgyi'o// tad+ya thā/ a ṭa ṭa/ na ṭa ṭe/ a na te nā ti/ kun ṭi swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag gis chos smra ba de dag la dpag tshad brgya tshun chad du bsrung bar bgyi'o// rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo mdo sde 'di lta bu 'dzin cing chos smra ba de dag la yang bsrung ba bgyi bar 'gyur/ bde legs su bgyi bar 'gyur ro// de nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dri za bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar nas/ 'khor der 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa de stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang mdo sde 'di lta bu 'dzin pa/ chos smra ba 'di lta bu de dag la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba'i slad du gzungs sngags kyi tshig rnams brjod par bgyi'o// tad+ya thā/ a ga ṇe ga ṇe/ gau ri/ gan+dha ri/ tsaṇ+ḍa le/

ma tang gi/ puk+ka sī/ sang ku li/ bru ṣa le swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis gsungs te/ gang zhig chos smra ba 'di lta bu de dag dang 'gal bar bgyid na de dag thams cad la 'khus pa lags so// de nas srin mo 'phyang ma zhes bya ba dang*/ srin mo rnam par 'phyang ma zhes bya ba dang*/ srin mo so brtsegs zhes bya ba dang*/ srin mo me tog so zhes bya ba dang*/ srin mo cod pan so zhes bya ba dang*/ srin mo skra can zhes bya ba dang*/ srin mo me zhes bya ba dang*/ srin mo phreng ba 'chang zhes bya ba dang*/ srin mo mdung can zhes bya ba dang*/ srin mo sems can thams cad kyi mdangs 'phrog ces bya ba dang*/ 'phrog ma bu dang g.yog tu bcas pa dang*/ srin mo de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas/ srin mo de dag thams cad kyis sgra skad gcig tu bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan bdag cag gis kyang mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa chos smra ba 'di lta bu de dag bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba bar bgyi'o// bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o// ci nas chos smra ba de dag la glags lta ba dang skabs tshol ba dag gis kyang glags mi rnyed par bgyi'o// de nas srin mo de dag thams cad kyis sgra skad gcig tu tshig mthun par bcom ldan 'das la gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag phul lo// tad+ya thā/ i ti me/ i ti me/ i ti me/ i ti me/ i ti me/ ni me/ ni me/ ni me/ ni me/ ni me/ tu he/ tu he/ tu he/ tu he/ tu he/ haste/ haste/ haste/ haste/ haste swā hā/ 'di spyi bor bzhag nas chos smra ba rnams la su yang 'khu bar ma gyur cig de skad ces gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis srin mo de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to// kye srin mo dag legs so// khyod kyis chos smra ba de dag la bsrung ba dang*/

bskyab pa dang*/ sba bar gyis shig gang dag tha na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming tsam 'dzin pa de dag la yang*/ mdung can khyod g.yog dang bcas pas bsrung bar bya'o// zhes gsol bas bcom ldan 'das kyis ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug chos byed pa dag bdud kyis bslus te mi dge bar 'gyur bar lung bstan kyang dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs las gzungs kyi le'u 'di 'chang ba'i gang zag de la nam yang bdud kyis bar du gcod par mi nus par gsungs so/ ༈ /chos 'chad pa sogs kyi tshe slob dpon khri la 'dug pa'i dus su blo gros rgya mtsho'i mdo las gsungs pa'i bdud tshar bcad pa'i sngags 'di bklag par bya ste/ tad+ya thā/ sha ma sha ma wa te/ sha mi rta shas+t+ru/ aṃ ku re maṅku re/ mā ra dzi te/ ka rā ṭe/ ke yā re/ te dzo lā ti/ o dzo yā ti/ biṣ+ṭe/ nirma le/ ma lā pa ne/ o ga re kha ge/ gra se gra sa ne/ o mu khe/ pa raṃ mu khe/ paṃ raṃ mu khe/ sha mi tā ni/ sarba gra ha ban+dha nā ni/ na ni gra hi ta/ sarba pa ra pra bā di na bi muk+tā mā ra pā shāḥ s+tha pi ta bud+dha mu dra a nuṅga ti ta/ sarba mā raiḥ a tsa li te/ pa ta pa ri shud+dhe/ bi gats+tshan tu sarba mā ra karma ṇi/ zhes bzlas pas bar chad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ ༈ /'gyur sngags ni/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra bi ma na sā ra ma hā dza wa hūm̐/ sngags 'di tshar gcig brjod na sngags gang bzlas pa de brgya stong du 'gyur bar gsungs so/ ༈ /oṃ sma ra sma ra bi ma na sā ra ma hā dzam+bha ye swā hā/ lan bdun brjod pas dge ba 'bum du 'gyur/ oṃ sma ra sma ra bi ma na ska ra ma hā dza ba hūm̐/ lan bdun brjod pas nyin zhag gcig gi dge ba gang byed stong 'phel du 'gro'o// bha ra so bha ra bhi ma na sa ra ma hā dzam+bha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gcig brjod pas 'bum 'gyur du 'gro bar gsungs so// oṃ dha re dha re bhan+dha re swā hā/ lan gcig brjod pas dge ba gang byas grangs med du 'gro'o// de nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa dang*/

tshe mdo sogs gzungs mdo rnams dang*/ gzhan yang phan yon can gyi gzungs sngags/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ a pra ti ha ta shā sa na nāṃ/ oṃ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ta thā ga tod+bha ba shān+te ba ra de ut+ta mot+ta ma ta thā ga tod+bha ba hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'di bzung bas 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa'i mdo gzung bar 'gyur ro// na mo bha ga ba t+yai/ ār+ya pra dzñā pā ra mi tā yai/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni dharme/ saṃ gra hā dharme/ a nu gra ha dharme/ bi muk+ti dharme/ sa dā a nu gra ha dharme/ bai shra wa ṇa pa ri brti ta dharme/ sarba kār+ya pa ri pra ma ṇa dharme/ sa man+ta a nu pa ri warta na dharme swā hā/ oṃ pradzñe shru ti smṛ ti ma ti bi dza ye/ dhīḥdha ra ṇī ye swā hā/ 'di bzung bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa gzung bar 'gyur ro// tad+ya thā/ oṃ pradzñā pradzñā+e/ pradzñā a ba bhā se/ pradzñā a ba lo ka ti/ sarba dharma an+dha ka ra bi dha ma ni/ sid+dhe su sid+dhe/ sid+dh+yan+tu mā bha ga wa ti sarba dzñā na saṃ dha ri bha ga wa ti wats+tshi la pra sa ra de ha sta ma ma su ka ra/ sid+dhi sid+dhi/ bud+dha bud+dha/ kaṃ pa kaṃ pa/ bā la bā la/ dha ra dha ra wa ra wa ra/ gardza gardza/ ā gats+tsha/ ā gats+tsha/ bha ga wa ti/ mā bi lam+ba swā hā/ 'di bzung bas sher phyin stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa gzung bar 'gyur ro// tad+ya thā/ oṃ hrīḥ shru ti smṛ ti bi dza ye swā hā/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā yai/ sarba durga ti sho dha ya/ ra dzā ya swā hā/ 'di bzung bas brgyad stong gzung bar 'gyur ro// oṃ n+thāṃ na maḥsarba bud+dha nāṃ/ oṃ māṃ/ bh+rūm̐ mūṃ/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bh+rūm̐/ 'di bzung bas 'phags pa phal po che gzung bar 'gyur ro// na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ti shā sa nā nāṃ/ oṃ dhu na dhu na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'di bzung bas 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdog gzung bar 'gyur ro// tad+ya thā/

oṃ pad+me pad+me de pa bi/ hi ne hi ne hi ne/ tsu lu tsu lu tsu lu/ hu le hu le hu le/ yu le yu le yu le/ ba le ba le ba le/ muṃ ts+tshe da na da de/ bhin de bhan dz+re/ ma na de pra ma de/ di na ka re swā hā/ gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag klog par byed pa des lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo thams cad bklag par 'gyur ro// na mo dharma kā ya/ saṃ bho ga kā ya/ nirmā ṇa kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ dā na pā ra mi tā/ shī la pā ra mi tā/ k+ṣān+ti pā ra mi tā/ bīr+ya pā ra mi tā/ dh+ya na pā ra mi tā/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā/ sarba dharma shū n+ya tā swā hā/ 'di bzung bas pha rol tu phyin pa drug gzung bar 'gyur ro// na maḥsarba tā nāṃ/ ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ da sha pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra kā nāṃ hī/ snying po 'di lan gcig thos pas pha rol phyin pa bcu thob par 'gyur ro// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ a mi ta bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a mi te/ a mi tod+bha be/ a mi te saṃ bha be a mi ta bi krān+te/ a mi ta ga mi ni/ ga ga na kīrti ka re/ sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ yon tan bsngags pa dpag tu med pa'i gzungs 'di lan gcig brjod pas bskal pa 'bum du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro// tad+ya thā/ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ shākya thub pa'i snying po'i gzungs 'di lan gcig bzlas brjod byas na bskal pa bye ba brgyad khri'i bar du sdig pa byas pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro// tad+ya thā/ a mi te/ a mi tod+bha be/ a mi ta saṃ bha be/ a mi ta bi krān+ta gā mi nī/ ga ga na kīrti ka re/ sarba kle ṣa k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa'i gzungs 'di'i yon tan ni bskal pa brgya stong du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa'ang lan gsum bzlas pa byas na de rnams zad par rig par bya'o// nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bzlas pa byas na rtsa ba bzhi'i ltung ba'i sdig pa yongs su byang bar 'gyur te/

sangs rgyas stong la dge ba'i rtsa ba skrun par 'gyur ro// tad+ya thā/ tsan+d+re tsan+d+re/ su tsan+d+ra/ ma ti tsan+d+ra/ tsan+d+ra ki ra ṇa/ si ri si ri/ bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ ki li ki li/ dharma a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ ki li ki li/ saṃ gha a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zla ba'i 'od de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dran par byed pa de ni bskal pa bzhi khrir tshe rabs dran par 'gyur te/ de ni ngan song du ltung bar mi 'gyur ro// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ a nu ga te/ oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ 'di lan gcig bzlas pas kyang bskal pa 'bum phrag brgyad stong du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yang zad par 'gyur ro// na mo rat+na shi khi ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ rat+ne rat+ne rat+na shi khi ne swā hā/ 'chi ba'i tshe dran na ngan song kun las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro// 'chi 'phos nas kyang sum cu rtsa gsum gnam gyi lhar skye'o// tad+ya thā/ ha na ha na sā ni/ na pa sā ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la ne/ tsa la tsa la ne/ pū rba/ yo ga ma nu sma ra phaṭa/ ma hā ha ta ya swā hā/ gang gis rig pa 'di bklags pa de tshe rabs brgya stong du skye ba dran par 'gyur ro// 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang bde ldan gyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te dharma dha du ni gardza ta rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ ku mā ra bhū tā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dzñā nā lo ke tri rat+na baṃ sha saṃ dhā ra ṇi/ bha ga ba ti/ a pā yaṃ dā di a bā yaṃ dat+te tsit+ta badz+ra ba ri pā la ya/ sa man+ta a ba bhā se na/ ha na ha na/ sarba satwa saṃ ta na pa ti taṃ/ kle shā nu ts+tshe da ya/ ba ra la k+ṣa ṇa/ a laṃ kṛ ta sha rī re/ bo dhi satwa shi shū pa ti pā la ya/ bud dhā na de shā ya/ de ba/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga ba she s+tha pā ya/ a pa yaṃ da da ti swā hā/

'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i gzungs 'di lan gcig brjod pas kyang bskal pa stong du las kyi sgrib pa bsags pa 'byang bar 'gyur ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas so// oṃ ghe tsa na hūm̐/ zhes pa 'di lan gcig brjod kyang bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig pa 'dag go /'jam dpal gyi yi ge brgyad pa/ oṃ a bhi ra hūm̐ khe tsa ra/ 'di dran pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga byang zhing myang 'das thob bo// 'jam dpal gyi yi ge 'bru gcig pa/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ k+ṣ+ṇiṃ/ 'di rab tu gsang nas bzlas na don dang las thams cad 'grub bo// 'di phyin chad kyi gzungs rnams kyi phan yon mang ches nas yi ges 'jigs pa yin pas dpyod ldan rnams kyis rtogs par 'dod na gzungs so sor blta bar bya'o// rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po'i gzungs/ tad+ya thā/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ bi ri bi ri/ hu ru hu ru/ bai ro tsa na rasmi sañtso pi ti ā gats+tsha ār+ya ā kā sha gar+bha mahā kā ru ṇi kā pū ra ya ha shā na/ dha ra ya bud+dhe bits+tsha yan/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das sman bla'i gzungs ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bhai ṣa dz+ye gu ru bai ḍūr+ya pra bha rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye mahā bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dzā sa muṅga te swā hā/ byams pas dam bcas pa'i sngags/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye ta thā ga tā ya ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a dzi te a dzi te a pa rā dzi te/ oṃ dzi tañdza ya ha ra ha ra mai tri a ba lo ki te ka ra ka ra ma hā sa ma ya sid+dhi bha ra bha ra ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍa bī dza sma ra sma ra āsma kaṃ sa ma ya bo dhi bo dhi ma hā bo dhi swā hā/ oṃ mo hi mo hi ma hā mo hi swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni sma ra swā hā/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs sngags/

oṃ bho hūm̐ hūm̐/ ā ā/ hī hī/ shi ba shi ba/ shān+ti shān+ti/ sha ma sha ma/ sha mā pa ya/ ta thā ga tā nu ga ta/ swa bhā ba/ a bhā ba/ sa mut+tā ya/ a sa ma ba la/ a bi ra la ba la/ a mi ta ba la/ a ti ba la/ hūm̐ ghuṃ ghuṃ/ dhau bhau bhau bhau/ bh+re du bh+re du/ hī hī/ bha ga bān/ bha bān ta ka su ra ta bho ga mahā shān+ti ka ra/ pā pa kilpi ṣa nā sha ka swā hā// sgrol ma'i gzungs/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā swa twa ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ pra duṣ+ṭaṃ ma ma kṛ te dzam+bha ya/ stam+bha ya/ mo ha ya/ bhan+dha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭa stam+bha ni tā re swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma rang gis dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tā rā yai/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ sa ma ya smṛ ti/ bha ra bha ra/ sarbā bha ra ṇi/ bi bhū ṣi te/ pad+ma ni pad+ma/ ma hā pad+ma/ ā sa na s+thi te/ ha sa ha sa/ tre lo kya ba ra de/ sarba de pa dā na pa/ pū dzi te sma dā hi/ bha ga ba ti tā re/ sma rā hī/ bha ga bā na ta/ ta thā ga ta s+ya/ pu ra taḥ sa ma yaṃ/ dha ra dha ra/ ma hā satwa a ba lo ki te/ ma ṇi ka ni ka bi tsi trā bha ra ṇe/ oṃ bi lo kā ya/ che ge mo/ bha ga ba te/ tā re/ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa/ na ma s+t+rai ya dh+wi kā nāṃ ta thā ga tā naṃ/ sarba trā pra ti ha tā bāp+ti dharma tā ba li nāṃ/ a sa ma sa ma sa man+ta to3nan+ta bāp+ti shā sa ni/ ha ra ha ra sma ra sma ra ṇa/ bi ga ta rā ga bud dha dharma te/ sa ra sa ra sa ma ba la/ ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ bha ga wān mahā ba ra lak+ṣa ṇe/ dz+wa la dz+wa la na sā ga re swā hā/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/

sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga bā na sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha ba/ mahā sa ma ya satwā āḥ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā lā ya/ he ru katwe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍo me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga bā na/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ dbyangs gsal/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ rten 'brel snying po/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī mahā shra ma ṇaḥ tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs/ oṃ a mo gha shī la saṃ bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shud+dha satwa/ pad+ma bi bhū ṣi ta bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭ/ yon sbyong ba'i gzungs/ na maḥs man+ta pra bhā rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te bh+yaḥsamyak+saṃ budhā ya/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ ku mā ra bhū tā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ni rā lam+be ni ra bhā se/ dza ye dza ya la b+dhe/ ma hā mā te dak+ṣā+e ṇī me pa ri sho dha ya swā hā/ yang yon sbyong gzungs/ na mo bha ga ba te/ su me ru kalpa rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ kalpe kalpe/ ma hā kalpe/ kalpa pa ri sho dha ni swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ oṃ mā rī ts+ye swā hā/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dzñā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/

'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ stong chen rab 'joms kyi sngags ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta ba re ba ra ba ra pra ba ra shud+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rma bya chen mo'i sngags ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo ki ni gar+bha saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi ā kar+ṣa ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin gyi sngags ni/ oṃ bi ma le bi pu le dza ya ba re a mṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi sngags ni/ oṃ bha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra in+d+ri ya ba la bi sho dha ni ru ru tsa la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bdud skrag par byed pa'i sngags/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi sha ta dīp+te dz+wā la dz+wā la dhar+m+ma dhā tu gar+bhe ma ṇi ma ṇi ma hā ma ṇi hṛ da ya ma ṇi swā hā/ bcings pa las grol ba'i sngags/ tā re tā re tā rā ya bha ga wa te ban+dha mo tsa ni swā hā/ bar du gcod pa sel ba'i rig sngags/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la hūm̐ phaṭa/ sar+b+ba bigh+nā ma ta ka rā ya bi nā sha ka ra mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ tad+ya thā/ badz+ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra/ sarba bya dhi ha na ha na/ badz+re na swā hā/ rims nad zhi ba'i gzungs/ tad+ya thā/ i li me ti me li/ ha ne su ha ne/ che ge mo zhig dz+wa ra ba na dhā mi/ e ka hi kaṃ tri hi kaṃ tsa turtsa kaṃ/ ni t+ya dz+wa raṃ swā hā/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i gzungs/ oṃ ku mā ra rū pa dhā ra ṇi bi shwa sam+bha pa ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ la ghu la ghu/ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzi na dzi ka mañdzu shrī ye/ tā ra ya māṃ/ sarba duḥkhe bh+ya phaṭa phaṭa/ sa ma ya sa ma ya/ a mi totabha botabha ba/ pā paṃ me nā sha ya swā hā/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i gzungs/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo mañdzu nā thā ya/ na mo ya mān+ta kā ya/

tad+ya thā/ oṃ mañdzu bha ra/ mañdzu gho ṣa ha na/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ be tse be tse/ bhi ta bhi ta/ i phu ta i phu ta/ he ra te sot+ta ni na maḥsot+ta ni/ bri pi sha le tad/ pri ta ha sa pra bhi na ta dza ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ he ra te sot+ta ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bā gī shwa ri muṃ/ mañdzu gho ṣa ha na/ pa ti sidho ha ri ṇi swā hā/ khro ba zhi pa'i gzungs/ oṃ ba ga ba tse/ dzaṃ bha ni/ staṃ bha ni/ mo ha ni/ sarba ro ṣa pra sha ma ni swā hā/ khros pa zhi ba'i gzungs/ ka ṭe bi ka ṭe/ ro ṣa pra na ma ni swā hā/ tshig btsan pa'i gzungs/ na mo bha ga ba te/ uṣ+ṇi ṣā ya dha re dhar n+te swā hā/ bdag srung ba'i gzungs/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a le kā li a le kā li mu ti tsha te swā hā/ don thams cad grub pa'i gzungs/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshes grangs dang rgyu skar dang yud tsam gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā/ nak+ṣa tre/ sarba ti thī murte/ na sha tra ni/ me sa mi ta dha ni/ bha ban+tu swā hā/ las grub pa'i gzungs/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na mas+saṅgā ya/ na mo ha ri dhi ye/ ha ri dhi ku mā ri/ gau ri/ gan dhā ri/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ ma taṃ gi/ ka li ka li/ che ge mo zhig gi mo he hi/ kha ra kha ra/ pa tsa pa tsa/ a ba dha ya/ mū ra tsā ya/ che ge mo zhig gi me sha ma nā ya swā hā/ oṃ dhu rabhu bā/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dz+wa li ma nā ni/ de bi sarba saskā ra ka ri ṇi dza/ ta le ta le/ dz+wa la dz+wa la swā hā/ yid du 'ong ba'i gzungs/ na mo bha ga ba te/ uṣ+ṇi ṣā ya/ dhā re dha ran+ti ye swā hā/ mgrin pa snyan pa'i gzungs/ oṃ bha ga ba ti shru ti smṛ ti/ ba la ba pa ra ma sid+dhi swā hā/ mchog thob pa'i gzungs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ shaṅkhi ni de bi/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ tiṣ+ṭha dha na/ dha na dza ye/ brī brī/ bṛd+dhi ka ri/ dh+ri dh+ri/

dh-i ti ka rī nā na/ ba bid+yā/ be sha bste/ ā yur+dha ra ṇi yu yu/ ā yuṣ+pā la ni/ ta thā ga tā sma ra bo dhi tsit+ta/ ma tī laṃ bo da ra/ de hi me ba ra ṇa shaṅkhi ni swā hā/ shes rab skyed pa'i gzungs/ hūm̐ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā bar+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dhā bar+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bud+dhi bar+dha ni swā hā/ yang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ tad+ya thā/ s+kha la te s+kha la te ma ni te swā hā/ yang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bi ba bi ba/ pradzñā bar+dha ni/ dza ra dza ra/ me dhā bar+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bud+dhi bar+dha ni swā hā/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ tad+ya thā/ ma ti ba hu l+ye/ ta thā ga tā dzñā na/ dar+sha ne pra dzñā p+ta/ gam+bhi re/ bo dhi maṇ+ḍa nu sa ri ṇi/ a bid+dha/ ta me ྅n+dha ku ra bi bhā ma ṇi/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pradzñā dī pe/ me dhā ba di ni sarba a dhiṣ+ṭhi ta/ su ru su ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ me dhā ā na ya swā hā/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs/ tad+ya thā/ smṛ te ma ti ma ti/ te dzo bid+ya/ hu ru me hu ru hu ru me kṛṣ+ṇa hu ru me swā hā/ spyod pa chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsar+b+ba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/ spel ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags/ na mas+sar+b+ba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsar+b+ba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ spyod par dbang ba shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags/ na mas+sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ ye shes skar mda'i sngags/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te/ na mas+saman+ta s+pha ra ṇa ra smi sam+bha ba sa ma ya/ mahā ma ṇi/ du ru du ru/ hṛ da ya dza la ni hūm̐/ dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i sngags/

na mas+sa man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ gra he shwa ri pra bhañtsa dza ti mahā sa ma ya swā hā/ lus kyi zag pa sbyin pa btang ba'i gzungs/ mchil ma la/ oṃ āḥsh+leṣ+mā ha re bh+yaḥswā hā/ lud pa la/ oṃ āḥkhre ra ā ha re bh+yaḥswā hā/ snabs la/ oṃ āḥsiṃ gha na ā ha re bh+yaḥswā hā/ lus kyi dri ma la/ oṃ āḥm la ā ha re bh+yaḥswā hā/ dri chen la/ oṃ āḥbiṭa ā ha re bh+yaḥswā hā/ dri chu la/ oṃ āḥmu tra ā ha re bh+yaḥswā hā/ de rnams so so la de dag za ba rnams kyis thob par gyur cig ces brjod par bya'o// se gol brdab bo// de rnams de ltar byin pa'i bsod nams ci bsags pa thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don tu byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// mchod rten sogs la/ me tog byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te puṣ+pe ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe puṣ+pe/ ma hā puṣ+pe/ su puṣ+pe/ puṣ+pa ud bha we/ puṣ+pa saṃ bha we/ puṣ+pa a wa ba ki rā ṇe swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun bzlas pa'i me tog rten la dbul/ des me tog ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi me tog bye ba phul bar 'gyur ro// rol mo 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsā li ni pradzñā pā ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha ba/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swā hā/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sā ra pra marda ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ṇe badz+re swā hā/ gzungs 'di dran pa tsam gyis phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma'i rdul phra rab ji snyed la mchod pa byas par 'gyur zhing zhabs la phyag byas par 'gyur ro// de nas rten la phyag bya bar 'dod na/

oṃ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ na maḥsu shrī yi/ na ma ut+ta ma shrī ye swā hā/ yang na/ na mo bha ga wa te rat+na ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ rat+ne rat+ne/ ma hā rat+ne rat+na bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes pa 'dis phyag bya ste/ mchod rten gcig la phyag byas pas mchod brten bye ba la phyag byas par 'gyur ro// yang bskor ba bya bar 'dod na/ sa gzhi gser gyi bye ma brdal ba'i steng du chu yan lag brgyad kyis gang ba'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po chen po'i steng du zla ba'i gdan la bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bzhugs pa la/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs bstims nas/ de dag la bsnyen bkur ba'i tshul gyis bshad ma thag pa'i phyag 'tshal ba'i sngags de'am/ yang na/ na mo da sha dik+t+ri kā la sarba rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥpra dak+ṣa su pra dak+ṣa sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes pa bzla bzhin du bskor ba bya ste/ bskor ba gcig byas pas dpag tu med pa byas par 'gyur ro// de'i tshe'am de las gzhan du'ang rung ste mchod rten gyi grib ma'am rdul lam me tog gi dman ma sogs la 'gongs pa nyes pa sel ba'i phyir/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūm̐/ zhes blos mkha' la btegs par bsams nas bskor ba sogs bya'o// smon lam 'grub pa'i gzungs ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā/ oṃ pañtsin+d+ri ya a ba bo dha ni swā hā/ oṃ du ru du ru dza mu khe swā hā/ dge sbyor gang byed kyi mjug tu lan bdun bzlas na dge sbyor gang byas 'bum dang bye bar 'gyur ro/ ༈ /de lta bu'i gzungs sngags zab mo rnams bzla ba'i skabs su phyag 'tshal ba 'di sngon du bya ste/

'jig rten ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// gang gis thog mar rig sngags rnams// dzam bu'i gling du gsungs pa yi// sangs rgyas dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// da ltar byung dang 'das pa dang*// ma byon sangs rgyas gang lags pa// thams cad lha dbang bdag phyag 'tshal// de dag rnams la skyabs su mchi// 'khor lo bskor ba bla med pa// mar me mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi rgyal po 'od mdzad pa// thams cad gnon la phyag 'tshal lo// thams cad mkhyen pa grags ldan pa// pad+ma'i bla la phyag 'tshal lo// spyan dang ldan pa skyabs mdzad pa// rab mthor gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// ded dpon bla na med pa po// grags pa'i bla la phyag 'tshal lo// nyi ma lta bur 'od mdzad pa// bde mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi me long ston pa po// don gzigs la ni phyag 'tshal lo// dul ba'i tshul khrims 'jig med pa// rgyal zhes bya la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan mchog sum bcu gnyis dang ldan// skar rgyal la yang phyag 'tshal lo// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal ldan pa// rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'od can gzi brjid ldan pa po// gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo// legs par mchod pa grags ldan pa// thams cad skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// bdud dpung rab tu 'joms mdzad pa// log dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo// bram ze dpal dang ldan pa po// gser thub de la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can kun la thugs brtse ba// 'od srung de la phyag 'tshal lo// shākya seng ge 'od mdzad pa// gser mdog can la phyag 'tshal lo// ser sna med pa thugs rje can// byams pa la yang phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal te// de dag la yang skyabs su mchi// gang dag gis ni chos bstan pa// sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo//
